note: The alate is unknown; the original's “Pseudo worker” is rendered here as pseudergate.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The holotype soldier is deposited in the Zoological Survey of India (ZSI); the type locality is Namdapha (Hornbill, Tirap District), Arunachal Pradesh, India. Soldier body length 10.0—11.2 mm, large for the genus; the frons slopes at about 70°, unlike the approximately 45° of most species in the genus. Known only from the type locality.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, slightly paler posteriorly; antennae brown; labrum dark brown; mandibles black; pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum brown; abdominal tergites pale brown, sternites cream. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 10.0—11.2 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, distinctly longer than wide; length to the mandibular bases 3.20—3.50 mm, width 1.90—2.05 mm, length 1.7—1.84 times the width; in lateral view the upper margin straight; the frons steeply sloping (about 70°), finely striate; on each side at the middle of the slope's origin a weak protuberance; Y-shaped suture present. Eyes translucent, small, elongate-oval, length 0.23—0.28 mm. Ocelli minute, dot-like, one on each side at the ends of the lateral sutures. Antennae short, 14—15 segments; segment 1 long, cylindrical, strongly sclerotized; segment 2 cylindrical, shorter than 1; segment 3 or 4 the shortest; subsequent segments progressively larger, broadly pyriform; apical segment short, oval. Labrum short, wider than long, length 0.28—0.35 mm, width 0.45—0.50 mm. Mandibles thick, short, stout, length 1.48—1.58 mm, less than half the head length; apex weakly incurved; the outer basal edge swollen and with several short hairs. Left mandible with 4 marginal teeth, the 1st and 2nd adjacent, the posterior edge of the 2nd long; the 3rd with a long curved posterior edge; the 4th short. Right mandible with 2 marginal teeth situated at the middle. Postmentum long, clavate; the wider anterior part with a shallow groove and several setae, sometimes slightly bilobed; the waist long and narrow, its width less than half to about half the maximum width; length 2.15—2.60 mm, maximum width 0.60—0.65 mm, waist width 0.28—0.33 mm. Pronotum flat, much wider than long, nearly as wide as the head; length 1.05—1.08 mm, width 1.93—2.03 mm; anterior margin deeply concave; posterior margin slightly concave. Mesonotum and metanotum narrower than the pronotum, the latter only slightly wider than the former. Legs short, stout; tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate; cerci 2-segmented; styli single-segmented, finger-like.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudergate: head cream; mandibles cream with dark brown to blackish-brown tooth margins; pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum pale yellowish brown; abdomen cream, paler than the head. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length about 7.0—9.5 mm. Head subcircular, slightly wider than the length to the mandibular bases; length 1.35—1.53 mm, width 1.50—1.58 mm. Antennae 14—15 segments; segments 3—6 or 3—7 short, annular; from segment 8 broadly pyriform. Eye spots translucent or pale grey, circular. Labrum wide, dome-shaped. Mandibles of the typical Kalotermes type. Pronotum semilunar; anterior margin deeply concave; slightly narrower to slightly wider than the head; length 0.88—0.95 mm, width 1.40—1.60 mm. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
